entityDescription:
The Istituto Superiore di Sanità(ISS) (Italian National Institute of Health) is the main Italian research institute in the biomedical and public health field. It is the technical and scientific body of the Italian National Health Service. The ISS activities include: promotion and protection of national and international public health through research, surveillance, regulation, control, prevention, communication, counselling and training. The ISS produces knowledge through research and trials and disseminates scientific knowledge and evidence to decision-makers, professional workers and citizens in order to protect and promote public health.
 
The technical and scientific area of the Institute includes6 Departments(Cardiovascular, dysmetabolic and ageing-associated diseases,Environment and health,Food safety, nutrition and veterinary public health,Infectious diseases,Neurosciences,Oncology and molecular medicine)16 National Centres(Addiction and doping, Animal research and welfare, Chemicals, cosmetics and consumer protection, Clinical excellence, healthcare quality and safety, Control and evaluation of medicines, Disease prevention and health promotion, Drug research and evaluation, Global health, Health technology assessment, HIV/AIDS research, Innovative technologies in public health, Radiation protection and computational physics, Rare diseases, Telemedicine and new health care technologies, Blood, Transplants), 2 Reference Centres (Behavioural sciences and mental health, Gender medicine) and5 Technical-scientific Services(Biological Service, Core facilities, Grant office and technology transfer, Research coordination and support, Statistics). Anotified bodyauthorized to issue EC certification of medical devices according to Council Directives 93/42/EEC and 98/79/EC, operates within the Institute.

Research, Trial, Surveillance and Prevention
The ISS collaborates on research activities and clinical trials with national institutions performing public health functions such as the Ministry of Health and the Ministry for the Environment, regions, local health units, hospitals and scientific institutes for research, hospital care and healthcare. The ISS research activities include a wide variety of fields: research and therapies against HIV/AIDS and related syndromes; research and analysis of population health from a global perspective to combat inequalities in access to healthcare services; research to validate diagnostic practices and therapies in gender medicine; research in the field of mental health to detect environmental etiopathogenetic mechanisms and to promote psycho-physical welfare; research, surveillance and prevention of addiction and doping; assessment of health risks arising from the use of chemical substances and cosmetics, prevention and surveillance of harmful substances and poisoning exposures; prevention of risks deriving from exposure to ionizing and non-ionizing radiation and development of methods in computational physics; coordination of animal testing activities to protect animal welfare; research and monitoring on quality and safety of delivering healthcare services to patients; assessment of health technologies; research in telemedicine, new health information technologies and innovations.
Health promotion
Promotion and protection of public health are pursued through activities carried out especially in the areas related to the following types of diseases: neurological, psychiatric, oncological, haematological, genetic, infectious, cardiovascular, endocrine-metabolic, immune-mediated, and ageing-related.

description:
221e is a leading global supplier of intelligent precision sensing solutions for smart devices. Our hardware platforms and AI-powered sensor fusion algorithms provide exceptional accuracy and consistent results alongside significant cost advantages. Since 2012, we have delivered innovative sensing solutions to power a wide variety of products, including wearables, sports equipment and industrial devices. For over a decade of field testing and scientific research, 221e’s advanced sensing technologies have been continuously refined to meet the accuracy requirements of the most demanding applications.

Key Products:
MPE > inertial sensor fusion embedded software library
MPE™ (Motion Processing Engine) is 221e core sensor fusion software enabling the highest accuracy and performance for 6-axis and 9-axis inertial orientation estimation (IMU). Based on a dynamically adaptive Extended Kalman Filter implementation, offsets compensation and automatic calibration procedures; it is the product of 10 years of extensive research, experience, and field tests for the most demanding applications. This is the source of a strong competitive advantage that positions 221e among the elite benchmarks of the market.

NeuraSense > embedded edge AI software
NeuraSense™ is a set of intelligent sensing libraries for consumer, automotive and industrial applications. Optimized for the edge, it provides real-time inertial sensor data processing enabling context awareness, gesture recognition, activity tracking, motion control, dead reckoning navigation, platform stabilization, and 8 use cases. Using TinyML real-time classifiers NeuraSense enables pattern recognition, event/anomaly detection, predictive maintenance and decision automation combining multiple sensor inputs to enable deeper insights and better accuracy.

Reefy is an innovative company dedicated to creating sustainable, nature-inclusive solutions for coastal and waterfront infrastructure. Our mission is to transform traditional infrastructure into systems that serve people while restoring marine ecosystems and enhancing biodiversity.
Our vision is to build a world where resilient coastal infrastructure works in harmony with nature, safeguarding both communities and marine life against the growing challenges of climate change.
To achieve this, next to our hardware solutions, we are developing the BlueBioMetrics Dashboard, a cutting-edge remote sensing platform. This dashboard will combine data from satellite imagery, water quality sensors, and eDNA analysis to monitor the health of marine ecosystems. Our goal is to provide real-time insights that empower clients to track the ecological impact of projects, meet regulatory requirements, and optimize sustainability efforts—all remotely. This scalable approach aims to extend our reach globally, enabling cost-effective and impactful infrastructure development.

At the core of our strategy is a commitment to collaboration, working closely with academic institutions, research organizations, and industry leaders to ensure that our products not only meet the needs of today but also anticipate the challenges of tomorrow. Whether it's creating advanced sensors, developing high-speed data transmission systems, we are driven by the vision of transforming how microwave and photonics technologies intersect to create smarter, more connected systems.
With a team of passionate engineers and researchers, we are laying the foundation for the next wave of innovation in microwave photonics, committed to creating products that shape the future of multiple high-tech industries.

entityDescription:
Pixel Photonics GmbH, founded in 2021 and based in Münster, Germany, is at the forefront of innovation in photon detection technology. The company specializes in Waveguide-Integrated Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detectors (WI-SNSPDs), a cutting-edge technology that integrates superconducting nanowires with nanophotonic waveguides on a single chip. This unique approach enables exceptional performance in single-photon detection, making Pixel Photonics a key player in fields such as laser communication and free-space QKD.

Pixel Photonics’ WI-SNSPD technology delivers superior detection efficiency across a broad spectral range, high timing precision, and extremely low dark count rates, all of which are critical for optical quantum communication systems. A notable feature is its polarization insensitivity, which ensures consistent detection performance regardless of light polarization—a vital characteristic for free-space communication. The detectors are also highly scalable, utilizing CMOS-compatible, wafer-scale fabrication processes to reduce costs and increase production capacity. Integration with photonic circuits further enhances performance by minimizing optical losses in free-space and on-chip applications.
With a steadfast commitment to innovation in photonics and quantum technologies, Pixel Photonics delivers scalable, affordable, and state-of-the-art solutions. Its participation in European R&D projects highlights the potential of its technology to address critical challenges in emerging quantum and photonics applications. By enabling groundbreaking advancements, Pixel Photonics is shaping the future of high-performance photon detection.

entityDescription:
SPALLIAN is a technology company specializing in data intelligence and geospatial solutions. We develop innovative software and tools to help administrations and organisations harness the power of location-based data for improved decision-making. SPALLIAN’s products range from geospatial data visualization to advanced analytics, enabling clients such as local authorities to gain valuable insights and serve the public interest.
While we serve a diverse range of clients, one of our notable areas of expertise lies in providing tailored services to local administrations (cities, inter-municipalities, regions…), helping these entities unlock the full potential of geospatial data for more effective governance and decision-making.
At its core, SPALLIAN is committed to leveraging location-based data to address the unique challenges faced by local governments and other public-sector organisations. For this, we are developing a geospatial data visualization platform that allows government officials and planners to visualize complex data sets on interactive maps, making it easier to understand spatial relationships and trends. This capability is invaluable for urban planning, infrastructure development and climate
change response, as it enables decision-makers to assess the impact of various scenarios and make data-driven choices.
As a consulting company, our advanced analytics capabilities are another asset for administrations. By harnessing geospatial data through robust indicators, we can perform in-depth analyses to identify trends, patterns and anomalies. This enables municipalities to optimize resource allocations, such as determining the most efficient locations for public services like schools, healthcare facilities, and economic clusters.
We also understand the importance for local governments of engaging with communities. As such, we offer solutions for citizen engagement and participation through a geospatial mobile app called thelma. This platform empowers residents to provide input on local issues, access important information and collaborate with government official, fostering transparency and accountability in local governance. It is currently used in +150 municipalities in France for eight years, and it is now being spread across Africa, starting with the cities of Kigali (Rwanda) and San Pedro (Côte d’Ivoire).
In addition to these technical capabilities, we place a strong emphasis on providing training and support to local administrations. We work closely with government team to ensure they have the knowledge and skills needed to effectively utilize geospatial tools data. Our approach not only helps public-sector organisations maximise their investment in geospatial technology, but also fosters a culture of data-driven decision-making.
Our commitment to the public sector goes beyond just providing tech solutions. We are dedicated to contributing to the improvement of communities and helping local administrations fulfil their missions. Whether it’s improving transportation systems, optimizing land use, enhancing healthcare and education services, or formulating effective economic strategies, our expertise in data plays a vital role in shaping the future of local governance.

entityDescription: Quantopticon makes game-changing software to accelerate the development and adoption of Quantum 2.0 photonic devices. Developed over a period of 15 years by a respected theoretical physicist, Quantillion is the world's first state-of-the-art quantum simulation engine for design, modelling and optimisation of quantum-optical components. Prior to Quantillion, best practices in optimising such components involved initial guidance by classical photonics design software, followed by a series of iterative trial-and-error experiments - a protracted and expensive process typically lasting several months. Classical photonics software is inadequate for calculating the required design features, on account of omitting quantum processes from the picture. By virtue of a cutting-edge quantum theoretical framework, Quantillion is uniquely capable of accurately describing and predicting the quantum aspects of light-matter interactions in quantum-optical systems. Consequently, it can faithfully simulate, and then optimise, quantum-optical components in a fraction of the time and at a fraction of the cost, by removing the need for costly and time-consuming experiments.

description:
TWI Ltd is one of Europe’s foremost independent research and technology organisations, working across all industry sectors, with expertise in solving problems in all aspects of manufacturing, fabrication and whole-life integrity management technologies. Services include a technical advisory service, information services, training, software and a range of different types of research/consultancy projects. The majority of TWI’s activity (75%) is contract research, funded by industrial members and built around the development of advanced technologies. TWI has over 600 industrial members in over 2,000 locations worldwide across a range of industries that includes automotive, engineering and construction, oil and gas, and aeronautics. 
TWI has worked on several programmes specifically for the aerospace sector. For example, in developing (process characterisation and validation testing) and applying the high integrity FSW process as the joining method of choice for the pressurised cryogenic external tank of the NASA Space Shuttle, in partnership with Lockheed Martin. Between 1997 and 2005, TWI assisted in the fracture mechanics integrity assessment of pressurised storage tanks for the Delta II and IV launch vehicle programmes. The European Space Agency, Materials and Processes Division (ESTEC) are currently industrial members of TWI. TWI has been working with ESTEC since 1990 and has completed a number of projects as listed in the experience section.

Cosmos for Humanity supports awareness, policy development and practical solutions to reduce space pollution and foster sustainable space activities.

entityDescription:
INSTITUTE
The Institute was established as a public institution for the performance of spatial planning activities for the Split-Dalmatia County in accordance with the Law on Spatial Planning and Construction (Official Gazette, No. 76/07). The decision on its establishment was made at the 27th session of the County Assembly held on 14 February 2008, and was published in the Official Gazette of the Split-Dalmatia County, No. 1/08.
The founder of the Institute is the Split-Dalmatia County.
ACTIVITY
- development, or coordination of development and monitoring of implementation of spatial plans at the regional level,- development of reports on the state of the space,- management of the spatial planning information system and its management within the scope of authority,- preparation of the starting point for development, or repealing of spatial plans for narrower areas,- issuing opinions in the process of development and adoption of spatial planning documents in accordance with the law,- development of the county spatial plan and development of spatial plans for cities and municipalities, urban development plans of importance for the State, or the county, if the development of these plans has been entrusted to the Institute by the competent ministry or county prefect,- performance of expert and analytical work in the field of spatial planning if the performance of these tasks is entrusted to the Institute by the competent ministry or county prefect.
The public institution has the status of a legal entity with the rights and responsibilities prescribed by the Physical Planning Act (Official Gazette, No. 153/13, 65/17, 114/18, 39/19, 98/19, 67/23).
DIRECTOR
The Director is the head of the Institute's operations, and is appointed and dismissed by the founder with the prior consent of the Ministry of Construction and Physical Planning. He is appointed for a period of four years, and the same person may be reappointed as Director.
The Director of the Institute is: Petar Matković, B.A.Arch.

entityDescription:
UNIQUE is a consulting firm for sustainable forestry and agriculture, rural development and natural resource management. Our core competencies are providing technical and economic solutions at the intersection of forestry, agriculture and climate change. We work on multi-year implementation projects and offer advisory services for public and private investment funds.
We have more than 20 years of experience providing tailor-made support to our clients in tackling technical, organizational and socio-economic challenges in land-use sectors, from project planning through implementation to evaluation.
Our know-how is in demand worldwide from a broad variety of clients. We work with devel-opment banks, multilateral organizations, ministries, municipalities, associations and the private sector.
UNIQUE was established in 1998 and is headquartered in Freiburg, Germany. Offices in Paraguay, Vietnam, Kyrgyzstan and representatives in Argentina and the UK are strengthening our regional presence. There are also temporary project offices in Colombia, Serbia, Kenya and Ethiopia. In Paraguay, our subsidiary UNIQUE Wood manages more than 15,000 hectares of FSC®-certified forests (natural forests, plantations and silvopastoral systems).
